t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Blue, orange, green and yellow are the best gnomes. Take your time and watch out for the colours swapping.

vb_textbox.text: Use the 1x to determine base output you can use for the 5x. These values will change so keep using 1x to determine which colour is best. I found that orange always tended to do well and purple tended to not do well. Try and figure out if the different forest effects output, i am not sure.
